_comment: The classification table the updater's preview reads (feat-foundry-adoption-npx-upgrade-2-0, AC-NPX-4/-6): every workspace path a run touches is exactly one of framework-owned, project-customization or retained-history. A path no pattern matches is project-customization. Patterns are workspace-relative; `*` stays inside one path segment, `**` crosses segments. Framework-owned is checked first, so a declared managed path under specs/ (the two README seeds) is framework-owned. Every retired-artifact catalogue entry is ALSO framework-owned; the updater adds those from retired-artifacts.json at run time, so they are not repeated here.
